subject.title: Las Virgenes Unified School District Board

text: Age: 40
Occupation: Educator/Parent

As an LVUSD teacher and the mother of both general and special education children, I will use my experience in the classroom, along with my experience as a parent in the district, to serve our community by supporting our families and teachers.
The issues that resonate most strongly with me include:

- Maintaining a strong curriculum that is practical, relevant, and prepares future generations for success.
- Supporting the use of technology as a tool to enhance education in a responsible, age-appropriate manner that encourages students to develop their own critical thinking and collaboration skills.
- Continuing our legacy of safety by protecting our schools through strong facilities, effective safety protocols, ongoing support for mental health awareness, and the promotion of positive school cultures.
- Working collaboratively with the district and LVEA to continue a longstanding tradition of trust, helping our district thrive while ensuring that funds are used responsibly and effectively to serve students and support educators.
For more information, visit: coraledwardsen.com

text: Occupation: Governing Board Member, Las Virgenes Unified School District
Experienced Leadership:

- LVUSD School Board Member
- Former Navy Officer
- Former Presidential Appointee to the U.S. Department of Education
- Former College Instructor, USC
- BA: UC Berkeley; MA: Johns Hopkins

As your School Board Member and as a current LVUSD parent of three students, I've focused on one goal these past four years: ensuring every student has the opportunity to succeed in a safe, supportive, and academically excellent school.
Together, we've raised student achievement in math and reading, made historic investments in student mental health and counseling, strengthened campus security, and improved school facilities.

We adopted the region's most comprehensive cell phone ban policy, helping students stay engaged in the classroom while improving attendance, reducing bullying, and creating a healthier learning environment. I also helped lead efforts to implement the region's strongest safety ban for high-speed e-bikes to better protect our students.

Looking ahead, my focus is clear: continue raising academic achievement, ensure technology is truly supporting learning by reducing unnecessary classroom screen time, maintain the safest schools possible, and prepare every student for success in college, careers, and life.
It's been an honor to serve our community, and I would be grateful for your vote.
www.dallaslawrence.com

text: I am running for the Las Virgenes Unified School District Board because I believe every student deserves an outstanding public education that prepares them for success in school, careers, and life.

For 40 years, I proudly served students, families, and our community as a Las Virgenes educator. I developed and supervised the LV Outdoor Education Program, taught incoming sixth-grade math remediation summer school, and taught adult education classes for California Lutheran University and the University of Phoenix.

My career has been defined by dedication, integrity, collaboration, and a commitment to helping every student reach their full potential. I value open communication and believe strong partnerships among teachers, parents, students, administrators, and the community are essential to student success.

As your board member, I will support rigorous academic standards, critical thinking, fiscal responsibility, transparency, and responsible decision-making. I will work to strengthen communication, encourage community involvement, and ensure every decision is guided by what is best for students.

Las Virgenes has a tradition of educational excellence. With decades of classroom experience and a deep understanding of our district, I am prepared to provide thoughtful leadership, listen respectfully, and work collaboratively to ensure our schools continue to offer exceptional educational opportunities for every student.
